basis: Written from DHA ST-28 §11.1.3 (a record of communication with the patient), ETSI TS 123 040 §3.1 (a receipt reaches an entity, not a person) and the AHRQ / BMJ Open Quality sources, before running the engine.
notes: A delivery receipt is not an acknowledgment: when the configured window passes with no acknowledgment, escalate.
reviewer_note: Added because no scenario covered delivered-with-receipt but never acknowledged (the user's first published case).
